title: Korean Namul Salad
description: A simple and healthy Korean-inspired salad made with namul, vegetables, and a hint of crunch.

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as shredded carrots, chopped cucumber, and sliced bell peppers

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the crumbled tofu, namul, and mixed vegetables.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the sesame oil and soy sauce.
3. Pour the dressing over the tofu and vegetable mixture, and toss to combine.
4. Sprinkle the crushed sesame seeds over the top of the salad.
5. Serve immediately, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
